messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: 5xx/timeouts spike detected in /v1/generate cluster redwood-hosted-eu at 2026-03-15T15:23:00Z. p95 latency 4.2s (baseline 0.6s), p99 11.8s, error rate (5xx+504) 6.7% (baseline 0.1%). Possible deploy at 2026-03-15T15:20:00Z (deploy-bot reported). paging oncall-jen :pager:
oncall-jen: on it, grabbing context
sre_jordan: I'm pulling traces and request logs now. any quick correlation id from the bot?
incident-bot: correlated_deploy_id: deploy-2026-0315-1520, cluster: redwood-hosted-eu, route: /v1/generate
eng_maia: that deploy rolled quantization/kvcache bump for the 13B models to reduce memory. i'm checking if the new kernel path has latency regressions.
sre_jordan: quick query from logs (last 5m):
```
SELECT percentile(latency_ms, 95) as p95, percentile(latency_ms,99) as p99, sum(status >= 500) / count(*) as err_rate
FROM request_logs
WHERE route = '/v1/generate' AND cluster='redwood-hosted-eu' AND ts > now() - interval '5 minutes';
```
results: p95=4200ms, p99=11800ms, err_rate=0.067
oncall-jen: thanks. are customers actively impacted? support_ana?
support_ana: we've got 18 tickets opened in last 10m, several saying "503s on prompts" and a large enterprise (acme-inc) reporting timeouts in their integration. CS flagged potential SLA hits.
pm_noah: flagging as P1. need rollback decision within 10m if customer impact is real and mitigation not trivial.
eng_maia: can we hotfix? i suspect the new batching logic plus the quantized kernel causes sync stalls at high concurrency. a rollback is fastest to restore SLOs.
sre_jordan: i can attempt temporary traffic shaping (route a portion to older variant) but control plane is currently respecting canary rules. we can force a cutover to previous model variant.
deploy-bot: Deploy history: deploy-2026-0315-1519 -> service:v1.8.2 -> changed config: kvcache=true, quant-mode=fast-q4, batcher=v2. Previous version: v1.8.1.
oncall-jen: i'm going to page infra to cut traffic to v1.8.2 and pin to v1.8.1. tagging owners. @deploy-bot, please run rollback-activate v1.8.1 -> redwood-hosted-eu now. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: Received rollback request. Initiating rollout: target version v1.8.1, scope=redwood-hosted-eu, strategy=immediate-rollback. ETA ~70s.
sre_jordan: running live check: tailing proxy logs to confirm 5xx sources; looks like worker processes hitting io waits, stack traces pointing to quant kernel path: LlamaKernel::execute -> kv_cache_lookup -> wait_for_mutex
eng_maia: that matches. probably a contention issue introduced with batcher=v2. will open PR after.
telemetry-bot: metric update: error_rate dropped to 2.3% at 30s into rollback, p95 down to 1.1s. continuing to watch.
support_ana: getting fewer tickets now, but acme-inc still reporting intermittent 504s. forwarding their request ids.
sre_jordan: confirming: 2 min after rollback complete -> p95 640ms, p99 920ms, err_rate 0.15%. Looks back to baseline.
oncall-jen: rollback confirmed. great. initiating customer comms draft for affected tenants. support_ana / pm_noah can you coordinate?
pm_noah: drafting email now. key points: incident window 15:20–15:26 UTC, root cause suspected regression from quantization + new batcher, mitigation was immediate rollback to v1.8.1. actionable items: revert batcher change in canary, add KV lock monitoring, regression test for quant kernel under concurrency.
sre_jordan: capturing logs and traces to incident board. will attach flame graphs and kernel-level traces.
eng_maia: temporary mitigations we tried: lowering max_batch_size and disabling kvcache, both reduced errors but caused throughput regression. rollback was best for SLA.
support_ana: CS notes: 2 enterprise customers opened SEV tickets, both on premium SLA. logged for credit review.
incident-bot: Incident annotated as "resolved" by oncall-jen at 2026-03-15T15:26:05Z. Follow-up: postmortem due in 48h. owners: eng_maia, sre_jordan, support_ana.
pm_noah: assign follow-ups: 1) add canary performance gate for quant/kv changes (eng_maia) 2) add synthetic load test for p99 under high concurrency (sre_jordan) 3) customer impact reconciliation and credit proposal (support_ana + finance).
oncall-jen: leaving handoff notes: rollback executed, baseline restored, monitoring dashboards show stable metrics for 15m after. will hand to daytime oncall.
eng_maia: I'll revert the batcher=v2 change in the feature branch and run the extended concurrency qtest.
sre_jordan: saved trace links: https://telemetry/redwood/trace/4132156780-rollback (internal). attaching stack samples.
support_ana: sent initial customer comms to affected customers, will update with postmortem.
pm_noah: adding postmortem template items to the incident board. please include exact deploy diff and perf graphs.
oncall-jen: heading OOTO in 10m — handing to oncall-day. @incidents: please ping oncall-day for follow-up if anything recurs.
telemetry-bot: 15m check: p95=610ms, p99=980ms, error_rate=0.12%. Stable.
eng_maia: thanks team. small note: we should add an automated rollback trigger if p99 > 5s for 2 consecutive minutes in prod. filing RFC.
sre_jordan: +1. logging captured, will keep traces for 7d.
support_ana: closing customer-facing thread after PM approval.
incident-bot: thread closed.
